03 · To help you choose

Frequently asked questions

Is the domain name included?+

The purchase and renewal of your domain name are defined in your quote. Chambre 17 can help you with every step. The domain remains registered in your name.

Is monthly management mandatory?+

No. Website creation and monthly management are separate services. If you do not choose a subscription, hosting and maintenance arrangements will be agreed before delivery.

Can I request changes after the website is built?+

Yes. Simple changes are included according to your management plan. Additional requests and new features are quoted separately.

Can I cancel my subscription?+

Yes. Subscriptions have no minimum commitment period and can be cancelled with 30 days’ notice. Website handover or transfer arrangements are specified in the agreed terms.

How long does it take to create my website?+

The timeline depends on the project’s complexity and the content available. We will provide an estimated schedule with your quote.

Will my website work on phones?+

Yes. All websites created by Chambre 17 are designed to work on computers, tablets and smartphones.
